author: The Current
description:
Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis talk about recording the song "When I Think of You" with Janet Jackson
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

When Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis had finished recording the album that would become Janet Jackson’s “Control,” they listened through the whole album with Janet and with her brothers, minus Michael. Janet’s brothers immediately sensed “When I Think of You” would be a No. 1 hit. Jam and Lewis were incredulous at first, but the prediction proved correct, and “When I Think of You” became their first No. 1 pop record. “The [Jackson] brothers had the ear for it,” Jam says. 

Hear more from Jimmy Jam in his and Terry Lewis’ interview with The Current’s Jill Riley in the video above. 

You can find Jam and Lewis’ complete interview here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bMhV5nKNH2E
